content: Eya manyuḵ gway mo. Gway jin yuḵu gom iya/ ma Guurah mo.

content.text: Ciḵi gwo yansan mo ma, aris ’kwani ’baar mo.
Dhali c̱iyi ’cem bum mo, aris um gun ’kokin e mony’cesh mo,
um gun gwa’da is mo dhali um gun ’bap̱kin mo,
dhali kun ta pa ki pa mo dhali kun hatha’do’d si’da/ mmonṯal ’de/ mo.
’Twa/ pem midi ṯor gwo gom moyuḵ mo.
Dhali gwom pem jin kulumka/ eya du mo tani minu mish ’ban mo be.
Aha/ mina ḵa’d ’cem pem ki gwom ’bi’th/e mo.
Aha/ mina gam gwom pem jin ’ce’dka/ agagala/ mo ki ko ma dheŋdhenye/ jin ’kon ma shu/i pesu/ mo.
Ki gomatinta imiga/ ḵo/ is goma risa tente/ kun ṯoju aha/ bwa mo,
ki imanmii tonthus kun ṯoci aha/ ’kus mo tani ’kamki aha/ mo?
Uni gun ta ’kwaniŋ gwaṯẖ kun ’ko ki ’kus gom tom buni kun tana uni mo
dhali dhu ’ba/ ki ca gom tom buni kun tana uni kun ishkin ka enthus ki pa jin tana uni mo?
Ka jiŋ gana/ wathiŋ kamu/ p̱iyi’d jin midi wan is piti ’ba/ mo,
walla c̱iya Arumgimis she/ yol gom mondiki/em piti mo,
haali/ mo jin wanu ’ba/ gom mondiki/em piti mo tani a’di ’bitha yol she/ ki ’bi’th mo,
dhali midi mol gam ki sule/ sule/ mo,
ki a’di midi ’taki ṯikir di ki e ki sule/ sule/ mo,
dhali mol jisa ’kulga/ p̱ar e mo.
Nye, a’di midi p̱ar e ka jiŋ gana/ ki isi ’kwani kun yuḵayuḵ wukin mo,
uni gun ta p̱us dhali uni gun dar gi bwaŋ’kup̱ mo tani uni mini mii inyaḵ ’ce’d sho’k imonṯal ’de/ mo
dhali dhal tom buni kun tana uni pa ki pa ki unin tiya mo be.
Jis jwam buni mo tani a’di ta pam buni jin mina uni ’ko ki sule/ sule/ mo,
a’di jin ta mo jin mina uni i’ko nyaḵka ris ’kwani ma nyaḵum yil buni mo,
ba uni ṯoshki yuḵa ’cesh gway ki jim buni mo.
Wathi/ mol c̱a’b ki e e ’penkap̱an piti jin tana a’di mo,
a’di wana e ki tonycuḵ kun ’ce’dki sho’k mo.
A’di yansan ta ’pemen gi uni gwansan kun ta p̱us mo kun wuna wuny jwa i is mo,
a’di ta ’pemen gi uni gwansan kun ’bora bwa gom tom buni gun pwaḵkunu uni mo. Doshi ma dhali ’cunycuri yan mo.
Me’d ḵa’bal mo tani uni dhukunu ’pen ka pije/ goma Haawiya mo.
Wu a’di midi ta amanhil uni mo,
ka ji sho’k gana/ bway jis jwa mo tani uni thulkunu mo be,
dhala yi’c buni midi shi/ is mo.
AHaawiya a’di midi ta pam buni mo be.
Hili Arumgimis midi wana ḵashiram pem ’ba/ mo ’peni mom’bi’th ma Haawiya mo,
haali/ a’di midi bu’th aha/ mo be. Doshi ma dhali ’cunycuri yan mo.
Dhalki is ki ḵo/ mo waḵki/ jan ṯal ’deŋ kamu/ ta pa ki pa mo,
ki monyca gi gu’b piti maru is mo.
Haali/ ki a’di midi wu mo tani toŋ kamu/ mina a’di ḵal ime’da?
Monycam piti midi diki ya ka luŋgu’b baṯẖ a’di nsho’k mo.
Ba, me’dyin dina a’di ki e mo tani a’di ki p̱ar is piti e ki a’di ’bora bwa ki ’bor mo,
dhali ba wathi/ maŋu mo ki a’di ki mii to ki ’bore/ gom is piti mo tani
a’di midi ya nyaḵki ’kwani ma nyaḵum yil gi icom mo,
uni gun mini mol moŋkush p̱ar e ki sule/ sule/ mo.
Wathi/ mol c̱a’bki e e ’penkap̱an piti jin tana a’di mo,
a’di wana e ki tonycuḵ kun ’ce’dki sho’k mo.
